statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete: all 58 catalog checks have one conclusive outcome.

page.framework: Server-rendered Java/JSP-style MPA with jQuery 3.4.1 and legacy Morfos/InfoWeb assets
page.notes: Public Spanish government expediente-status service. Entry page plus the personal-data/CAPTCHA form were audited; Cl@ve identity-provider internals and submission with real personal data were excluded.

artifacts.caption: Atomic 58-check coverage manifest and evidence plan.
Entry page at desktop viewport.
Entry page reflowed at 360x800.
Mobile layout metrics: no horizontal overflow and CLS 0.
Entry page remains light under the dark preference.
Controls and text remain visible under increased contrast.
Rendered entry-page DOM, CSS and metadata.
Computed CSS, scripts, focus indicators, metadata and semantics probe.
Reduced-motion probe found no active animation to suppress.
HAR of entry-page load.
HAR summary: 17 requests, 880,982 bytes, synchronous head scripts, missing cache headers and uncompressed resources.
DevTools performance trace of entry-page load.
Trace summary: LCP 1.81s in this run, no long tasks or TBT.
Lighthouse JSON for performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO.
Compact Lighthouse results: LCP 6.5s, CLS 0.049, TBT 0ms, unused CSS/JS and platform warnings.
axe-core results: invalid menubar/navigation semantics, list semantics and heading order.
Image audit: four images lack dimensions; three hidden loaders lack alt.
Security-header audit: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing, referrer and permissions policies absent.
Cookie audit: seven cookies; six are not Secure and all use SameSite=None.
Tracker audit found legacy Google Analytics requests.
Client-side secret scan found no exposed credentials.
Raw-vs-rendered comparison: 13% content overlap; raw title and H1 absent.
Browser-rendered entry page.
Crawler view displays a JavaScript-required warning and incomplete page.
robots.txt request returned a 404 Tomcat document.
No service worker registration; unknown route returns bare 404.
Desktop form reached through the primary journey.
Mobile form: reflow succeeds, CAPTCHA helper icons are broken.
Form probe: fields lack programmatic labels, required state and autocomplete; CAPTCHA helper images fail.
Baseline heap summary: 95,566 nodes and 5,156,015 self-size bytes.
Heap after 20 menu toggles: 96,597 nodes and 5,269,959 bytes; no Detached constructor in top summary.

paths.description: Entry/choice page, representing the public landing template and choice between Cl@ve and manual lookup. Audited at desktop, mobile, dark, contrast, reduced-motion and crawler conditions.
Primary manual expediente lookup journey from entry to /consulta.html, representing the form template and identity/CAPTCHA flow.
Unknown route plus robots.txt/sitemap.xml responses, representing HTTP failure handling and indexing infrastructure.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical to the light capture; the computed probe reports colorScheme "normal" and no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, border and control tokens.

findings.summary: The entry-to-form navigation swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: The primary flow navigates from /infoext2/ to /consulta.html, while CSS inspection found no view-transition rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a cross-document View Transition for this same-origin MPA journey, with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome is static and consumes space without adapting to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a fixed-height application bar, and CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce or adapt the header after scroll using CSS scroll-state/container-query guidance where supported.

findings.summary: A custom hidden dialog is implemented with divs rather than the dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found .mf-dialog and a veil but zero <dialog>, popover or <details> elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace modal behavior with <dialog> and native close/focus semantics.

findings.summary: Responsiveness is viewport-driven rather than component-driven.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout works, but CSS inspection found no @container rules and 565 physical-direction declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Define reusable modules as containment contexts and move local layout switches to container queries.

findings.summary: Primary actions have no visible keyboard focus and several targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline-style:none for Menu, Volver and both entry CTAs; their heights are 38px, with the menu only 40x38px.
findings.suggestedFix: Add high-contrast :focus-visible styling and increase interactive target boxes to at least 44x44 CSS px.

findings.summary: The form’s CAPTCHA recovery controls are visibly broken.
findings.evidence: The desktop and mobile form screenshots show broken images for “Escuchar pista sonora” and “Recargar Captcha”; the probe reports naturalWidth 0 for both.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve working audio and refresh controls as real labelled buttons, announce refresh/error state, and provide a non-visual alternative.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance is inconsistent and slow under Lighthouse simulation.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 6.4s and LCP 6.5s (performance 0.61), although the separate trace measured LCP 1.81s; this variance indicates fragile delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove blocking and unused resources, compress responses, and remeasure under representative network and device conditions.

findings.summary: Critical resource delivery is dominated by uncached, uncompressed, render-blocking assets.
findings.evidence: The HAR transferred 880,982 bytes; a 543,793-byte stylesheet and six synchronous head scripts have no async/defer, and the summary flags missing cache headers and no content encoding.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress text resources, add immutable caching for versioned assets, split critical CSS, and defer non-critical scripts.

findings.summary: Most of the shipped CSS and substantial JavaScript are unused on the primary page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 516 KiB unused CSS (97% of styles-sede.css) and 155 KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Create a route-specific CSS bundle and remove or conditionally load jQuery, tooltip, datepicker and framework code not needed on the entry page.

findings.summary: Navigation roles and form-field naming are not programmatically sound.
findings.evidence: axe reports a critical aria-required-children failure on nav role=menubar and serious list semantics failures; the form probe reports no associated labels or aria-labels for NIE, date, year and CAPTCHA inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a normal <nav><ul> structure unless a true ARIA menubar is implemented, and associate every field with a <label for>.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy skips levels and important controls suppress focus indication.
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse flag H1-to-H4 heading order; computed focus styles are none for the primary CTAs and menu button.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sequential H1/H2 structure and a consistent, visible :focus-visible ring.

findings.summary: Reflow works, but target sizing and the CAPTCHA alternative are not inclusive.
findings.evidence: At 360px the layout has no horizontal overflow, but entry controls are 38px high and CAPTCHA audio/refresh images fail to load.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain the successful reflow, enlarge targets, and provide functioning keyboard-accessible CAPTCHA audio and refresh controls.

findings.summary: Image assets omit intrinsic dimensions and hidden loaders omit alternative treatment.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found four of four images without width/height and three ajax-loader images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width and height on images; give decorative/status loaders empty alt plus an announced status where needed.

findings.summary: The page ships deprecated and stale platform code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports a deprecated unload listener, while the DOM loads jQuery 3.4.1, Modernizr and multiple old synchronous utility bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload handlers, audit and update libraries, and replace feature-detection/polyfill code with current platform capabilities.

findings.summary: Key actions and robots discovery are not reliably crawlable.
findings.evidence: Both entry CTAs use href="#" with onclick submission, and /robots.txt returned a Tomcat 404 document; Lighthouse also marked robots.txt invalid.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real action URLs or semantic submit buttons and publish a valid robots.txt.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap indexing signals are absent.
findings.evidence: The probe found no canonical or hreflang; both /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml returned the same 404 document.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical URLs and a valid sitemap, then reference the sitemap from robots.txt.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but transport hardening and cookie flags are unsafe.
findings.evidence: The header audit found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; the cookie audit found six cookies without Secure and all seven with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, CSP and nosniff; scope cookies to Secure, HttpOnly where applicable, and Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is required.

findings.summary: Legacy analytics tracks a sensitive government-service journey by default.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found ssl.google-analytics.com; seven legacy __utm*/infrastructure cookies are set, including a 400-day __utma cookie, with no consent surface observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove legacy analytics or switch to a data-minimised, consent-aware first-party measurement design with short retention.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are entirely absent.
findings.evidence: CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and X-Content-Type-Options are all missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, HSTS, nosniff, strict referrer policy and least-privilege permissions policy.

findings.summary: Core content and the primary journey require JavaScript.
findings.evidence: The crawler comparison reports only 13% content overlap, raw title/H1 absent, and the no-JS page explicitly says JavaScript is required; entry actions rely on onclick form submission.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the core heading, choices and real form actions server-side, then layer JavaScript enhancement on top.

findings.summary: Unknown routes fall through to a bare server error without recovery.
findings.evidence: The resilience probe and robots/sitemap requests returned generic Tomcat 404 pages with no path back to the service.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a branded 404/error template with an explanation, return-to-service link and retry/help options.

findings.summary: Spanish language metadata is correct, but layout CSS is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The page declares lang=es, but CSS inspection found 565 physical left/right declarations and zero logical-property declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace physical positioning and spacing with inline/block logical properties and test RTL expansion.

findings.summary: Required form state and CAPTCHA recovery are not conveyed accessibly.
findings.evidence: The form probe found required=false and no programmatic labels on every visible field; broken CAPTCHA helper controls prevent reliable recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark required fields semantically, validate after interaction, link errors with aria-describedby, announce summaries, and repair CAPTCHA alternatives.

findings.summary: The identity form provides no autofill or input assistance metadata.
findings.evidence: NIE, presentation date, birth year and CAPTCHA controls all report empty autocomplete, no inputmode/pattern, and the date remains a generic text field.
findings.suggestedFix: Add appropriate autocomplete/inputmode tokens, clear examples, and use a date input or accessible masked date guidance with fallback.

findings.summary: The page transfers large quantities of code that its simple entry view does not use.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 516 KiB unused CSS and 155 KiB unused JS; HAR total is 880,982 bytes for a mostly text-and-button page.
findings.suggestedFix: Build minimal route bundles and conditionally load form, datepicker, tooltip and framework code only when required.

findings.summary: Legacy analytics adds third-party work without visible user value.
findings.evidence: Two Google Analytics requests transfer 18,266 bytes and set long-lived tracking cookies during the sensitive service entry journey.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the legacy tracker or delay a privacy-preserving measurement request until consent and a meaningful event.

Add form autocomplete, input modes and accessible date assistance
Set intrinsic image dimensions and remove deprecated/stale platform code
Provide a useful branded HTTP failure and recovery state
Move layout spacing/positioning to logical CSS properties
